description: Quote a buy or sell on an existing Solana mainnet Limitless bonding curve from current on-chain reserves and fees. No signing or submission. Unsupported pending, completed/AMM and EVM trades return errors.

mint.description: Solana token mint; only existing Limitless bonding curves.
